mutations.name: the patch replaces the whole chapter instead of splicing in place
mutations.find: const beats = chapter.beats.map((beat) => (byId.has(beat.id) ? { ...byId.get(beat.id), id: beat.id, chapter: beat.chapter } : beat));

mutations.name: a patch naming other beats, or leaving one out, is merged

mutations.name: a row naming the chapter still gets a beat patch
kills: beat-level chapter repair falls back to the whole chapter when a failing row names the chapter rather than a beat
